_comment: TrueForge standalone HTTP endpoint. Override with TRUEFORGE_URL or TRUEFORGE_API_KEY env vars. decisionTimeoutMs is the fallback threshold the orchestrator enforces per agent decision. A REAL measured steward turn against nvidia/gpt-oss-20b took 65-95s (see ASTRIX_VISUAL_BUILD.md), so 60s guaranteed a timeout on every TrueForge turn; 240s gives real LLM turns headroom while still bounding a true hang. src/server/index.ts applies the same 240s default when ASTRIX_RUNTIME=trueforge and no ASTRIX_DECIDE_TIMEOUT_MS is set.
